t: Multiple $(l:laserio:laser_node)Laser Nodes$(/l) can be connected directly to each other using the $(l:laserio:laser_wrench)Laser Wrench$(/l), however the maximum range is 8 blocks. $(br2)Laser Connectors can act as a cheaper intermediary point between nodes, allowing you to build a network of interconnected inventories.
多个$(l:laserio:laser_node)激光节点$(/l)可由$(l:laserio:laser_wrench)激光扳手$(/l)互相直接连接，但连接长度不得超过 8 格。$(br2)激光连接器是造价较便宜的中介装置，专用于中继节点，可由此构建互相联通的激光网络。
